changes: Comparison completeness requires configuration and unique coverage for every selected, severity-eligible facade analyzer; selected unavailable, failed, or nonvacuous insufficient work cannot prove complete populations, even with zero unmatched findings.
Missing counterpart coverage marks unmatched findings unassessed instead of resolved or introduced.
Vacuous no-eligible-unit cases, intentionally disabled/unselected/empty-lexicon work, author intentions, and fully assessed deterministic fallback retain existing comparison semantics.
CLI strict coverage uses exact intentional-disable reasons through Coverage::is_intentionally_disabled; onnx_feature_disabled cannot bypass --require-complete.
Explicit adapter-only rule selection already fails Configuration::validate; default rule selection excludes non-facade registry entries from completeness requirements.

validation.clippy: cargo clippy --locked --features cli --test release_integrity --test cli --bin narrative-lens -- -D warnings

limits: No full Rust, Node, or package gate repeated here; coordinator runs final integrated gates.
Completeness concerns the selected supported candidate population and documented eligibility policy, not exhaustive semantic understanding.
